description: A video's storyboard in full: every shot (picture, line, text, seconds, direction, takes), the style and models it is made with, the presenter, cards, the finished render, and what is missing before it can render. `engine` says how it is cut (ffmpeg: the joiner; remotion: a code film), `cut_choice` who chose that and why (the Creative Director picks per film; `engine` follows when she reaches the cut), and `code` where a code film stands (version, checked, errors; get_video_code for the project).
name: get_video
title: Get video
